title: Abalindi Begadi
intro: Kwigadi eyomileyo, uluntu lwenza isifungo esinzulu. Kodwa isigqibo sabo savavanywa xa intando kaThixo yangenelela, yaguqula ubuhle babo baba lilizwe elingenanto.
clues: Sasikelelwe ngegadi etyebileyo, kodwa saba nekratshi.
Senze icebo lokuvuna ngaphandle kokwabelana nabantu abahlwempuzekileyo.
Kodwa xa sifika, safumanisa ukuba igadi yethu yayitshatyalalisiwe ngobusuku obunye.
Saqonda impazamo yethu saza saqala ukutyholana.
Ekugqibeleni saguquka, kodwa isifundo safundwa kade.
arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
